import subprocess,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
source=Path('crates/logex-storage/src/native/storage.rs')
original=source.read_bytes()
try:
 text=original.decode(); index=text.rfind('}')
 source.write_text(text[:index]+Path('/tmp/logex-immutable-canonical-growth-probe.rs').read_text()+text[index:])
 result=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--release','--lib','--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 Path('/tmp/logex-immutable-canonical-growth-build.log').write_text(result.stderr)
 Path('/tmp/logex-immutable-canonical-growth-build-messages.jsonl').write_text(result.stdout)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
 artifacts=[json.loads(line)['executable'] for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if json.loads(line).get('executable')]
 assert len(artifacts)==1
 shutil.copy2(artifacts[0],'/tmp/logex-immutable-canonical-growth-tests')
finally:
 source.write_bytes(original)
note: Single release growth diagnostic after the canonical reference guard and before the separate padding normalization fix. Populated fixture padding is zero. All exact row oracles pass. File growth/allocated blocks are not device write counters; timings are not repeated acceptance measurements. The earlier fallback executable run after a failed refresh is excluded.
